Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Left join docs on assays.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id and doi. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
